# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-19 from the 2026-11-19 Hub dump.

- 3,247,916 models tracked, 937,076 declare a base model, 970,439 parent links, 92,938 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
